title: Bud and the Tub
lines: Mom, Gus and Bud are at the tub.
But Bud sits on the rug and hums.
Gus got a cup and a tin jug.
He dips the cup in the tub.
Gus tips the cup in the jug. Fun!
Bud got up and ran. He got in!
Bud tips the jug on Gus. Gus is wet!

questions.ask: Where was Bud sitting instead of getting in the tub?
questions.listenFor: On the rug. Line three says it. If your child is not sure, put a finger on that line and let them read it again.

questions.ask: What did Gus do that made Bud want to get in?
questions.listenFor: He made a game with a cup and a jug, dipping and tipping. Lines four to six carry it.

questions.ask: Was there a part that made you laugh? Which one?
questions.listenFor: Most children pick the last line, when Bud tips the jug on Gus. Ask them to read it back.
